description.en: Changes the brightness of a screen and waits until the change is done. With SCREEN_AB it uses CMND_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL and waits on CMND_IS_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL; otherwise CMND_BRIGHT_FADE and CMND_IS_BRIGHT_FADE for that screen. Brightness -1.0 is black and 0.0 the normal picture.
SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) or SCREEN_AB (2, both).
Target brightness: -1.0 for black, 0.0 for normal.
Length of the fade in frames (EV_FADE_QUICK = 5, EV_FADE_NORMAL = 10, EV_FADE_SLOW = 15); 0 for an instant change.

examples.case: Fade out, then back in (real usage, the two most common calls)
